messages:
maria: Quick design question — new dashboard "resource card" shows action icons only on hover. On desktop it looks tidy but I'm worried about accessibility for keyboard and touch users. Current touch target for icons is ~28px. Should we standardize to 44px?
ash: Agree we should hit 44px. Our density goals make that tricky but we can expand hit area with invisible padding instead of changing visual size.
sam: Keyboard note — focus currently lands on the whole card, not individual icons. Screen reader users won't be able to trigger the specific action without an extra step.
maria: Suggested approach: keep hover reveal for mouse, but icons must be tabbable and have focus-visible outlines. Also increase touch hit area via pseudo element/padding so layout doesn't shift.
kevin: Implementation idea: add a .hit-area pseudo-element or use padding+negative margin. Watch z-index since pseudo-element can intercept pointer events. Example:
```
.icon-button { position: relative; }
.icon-button::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -8px; border-radius: inherit; }
.icon-button { outline-offset: 2px; }
``` 
But we need pointer-events: auto on the pseudo if it's used to enlarge click area, and ensure it doesn't break stacking.
ash: Alternative: keep a visually tight icon but wrap it in a larger <button class="icon-hit"> that has transparent background and no layout change. Then style focus on the inner icon for visuals.
sam: Also strongly recommend explicit aria-labels for each icon (e.g., aria-label="Bookmark resource", aria-label="More actions"). Tooltips are fine but not a replacement.
designbot: Accessibility checklist updated: "icon buttons must have aria-label, 44px minimum touch target, visible keyboard focus, and be individually tabbable" — added to #design-accessibility doc.
maria: Copy tweak: change tooltip for the run action from "Run" -> "Run query" to improve clarity for screen readers and less context ambiguity.
kevin: One extra nit on spacing tokens — when cards are compact, the icon row can feel cramped. Can we use spacing-token--sm instead of token--xs between icons and token--md around the hit area?
maria: I'll update the Figma component with the focus states, add the updated tooltip copy, and attach a quick keyboard nav prototype. Sam, can you add a quick accessibility test to the sprint for keyboard + NVDA/VoiceOver?
sam: Yep — I'll cover: tab order, focus ring contrast, aria-label readout, and touch hit target on mobile.
maria: Thanks! I'll post the Figma link in here once updated :sparkles:
ash: :thumbsup:
